agyos_skill.intent: Comprehensive operational runbook for Google Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) programmatic access via CLI (nlm) and MCP server (gemini-notebook-mcp), based on jacob-bd/gemini-notebook-mcp-cli. Source-grounded queries, multi-format sources, automated research, studio audio/video artifacts, and Google Workspace exports.
agyos_skill.instructions: This runbook defines patterns for interacting with Google Gemini Notebook (formerly Google NotebookLM) programmatically using the `gemini-notebook-mcp` FastMCP server and the `nlm` command-line interface based on [`jacob-bd/gemini-notebook-mcp-cli`](https://github.com/jacob-bd/gemini-notebook-mcp-cli). - **Source-Grounded Extraction**: Query notebooks with direct citations mapped to uploaded source text, minimizing hallucinations. - **Multimodal Ingestion**: Ingest web URLs, raw text, local files (PDFs, text files), and Google Drive assets. - **Automated Research Pipelines**: Run Web or Drive research tasks in fast or deep mode to discover and import new sources. - **Studio Artifacts**: Synthesize notebook contents into Audio Overviews, video scripts, infographics, slide decks, study guides, quizzes, and interactive reports. - **Google Workspace Export**: Export structured tables to Google Sheets and reports to Google Docs. Follow [references/AUTHENTICATION.md](references/AUTHENTICATION.md) for credential setup. 1. Ensure session cookies exist in `~/.config/gemini-notebook-mcp/cookies` (file permissions `600`) or set the `NOTEBOOKLM_COOKIES` environment variable. 2. The launcher script [mcp/gemini-notebook-mcp.sh](../../../mcp/gemini-notebook-mcp.sh) manages headless execution and loopback binding. 3. Access via AGYOS CLI: ```bash bin/agyos nlm <command> bin/agyos gemini-notebook <command> ``` When tasked with querying documentation or proprietary materials: 1. **List available notebooks**: ```bash bin/agyos nlm notebook list ``` 2. **Retrieve or verify notebook contents**: ```bash bin/agyos nlm notebook get <notebook_id> ``` 3. **Execute targeted query**: ```bash
